cs.t: This conversation reminds me of how predatory _all_ of the big players ToS were when I was shopping for a large (think for outdoor use) BT speaker. Every single one of the mainstream speakers had terrible data collection allowed by their "privacy" policy. I ended up ordering one from Monoprice that did not even have a ToS.
cs.th: Bose is open-sourcing its old smart speakers instead of bricking them

cs.t: This is actually what I did in our previous home. Installed round Monoprice brand in-wall speakers, and hid the AV equipment in the next room, one wall away. It sounded--not too bad.
cs.th: Samsung is paying $350M for audio brands B&W, Denon, Marantz and Polk
